title: Clear answers before you begin
intro: A straightforward guide to sessions, boundaries, privacy, and what spiritual guidance can and cannot do.

sections.heading: What happens in a session?
sections.body: We listen to your question, reflect together, and end with a grounded next step.

sections.heading: Do you guarantee outcomes?
sections.body: No. We do not promise to control another person, predict a fixed future, or guarantee money, love, or healing.

sections.heading: Can I ask for a specific ritual?
sections.body: You can share what you are looking for. We will explain what is appropriate and never use fear or pressure.
